verdicts.cmd: cd "${WYRD_REPO:-../wyrd}" && cargo deny --frozen --all-features --config deny-all-features.toml check advisories
verdicts.hint: the target's all-features advisory wall (the second cargo-deny step of cargo xtask ci) fails on the base, so every bundle's gating C4-ci is red until a separate deny-all-features.toml PR records or clears the new advisory (#543; precedent #790/#773). Offline and read-only (--frozen: cached advisory DB, Cargo.lock unchanged), so it reflects the DB the last C4-ci run fetched; it checks ../wyrd as checked out, or $WYRD_REPO
verdicts.detail: detect cmd exited 1 — absent on this host
